description: Revert to the empirically proven "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, Weight Decay=0.1, Batch=128) which consistently yields the lowest val_bpb (~0.9901-0.9905) and stable convergence, as recent capacity increases (Depth=10, 12) failed due to time budget or OOM, and shallower models (Depth=6) underfit, while aggressive/conservative LR tweaks on Depth=8 degraded performance.
